summary.text: Josh Schriver is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 66 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Josh Schriver's general-election opponent is Ned Zimmer (D).
He has worked as a healthcare consultant and a behavior analyst and lives in Oxford, Michigan.

paragraphs.text: Josh Schriver was born in Michigan, lives in Oxford, Michigan, and graduated from De La Salle Collegiate High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2015 and a master's degree in psychology, and his career experience includes working as a healthcare consultant and a behavior analyst.
Schriver assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and in 2025-2026 is assigned to the Communications and Technology Committee and the House Oversight Committee.
